latin: Quare solum de inherentia passionis ad subiectum habetur scientia.
translation: Why scientific knowledge is had only of the inherence of a property in its subject.
translator: original translation, drafted 2026-09-26 by WRITER-light-batch10, from Latin at farmer1998:24496
translation_note: 'passio' at farmer1998:24496 is the Aristotelian technical sense of a proper attribute or property, not 'passion' in the emotional sense.
